referee_caveats_inferred: Only nine sources, with just four new ALMA targets; the 0 (+17/-0)% detection rate is a weak upper bound
Heterogeneous spatial resolutions and HCN-vib measurement methods across literature sources (continuum-sized vs beam-sized apertures; NGC 1068 limit at ~15 pc)
Boxcar line assumption sets the upper limit; real HCN-vib width may differ and the 3-sigma limits depend on the continuum subtraction quality
Outflow non-detection relies on 33 km/s-smoothed HCN (3-2) cubes and moment/PV inspection only, with no quantitative outflow-wing fit
AGN position for NGC 7130 unresolved, so the continuum surface brightness comparison depends on the peak chosen
Evolutionary-sequence conclusions rest on literature outflow census and timescale arguments that are qualitative

reproducibility.score_reason: Project code, CASA version, robust, channel width, lines, rest frequencies, and numeric tables are given, but line-free channels, imaging geometry, masks, apertures and PV axes are not, and data public status is not stated; literature inputs must be gathered separately.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The single ALMA project (2017.1.00598.S) is from a 2017 cycle and should be in the public archive; flux, FWHM, upper-limit and surface-brightness values are tabulated so a redo of continuum, line fluxes and HCN-vib limits is feasible, although the data-public status is inferred rather than stated.
